arguments.command:
tput cuu 1 && printf "
📦 Updating composer packages...
" && termy_say "Updating composer dependencies" > /dev/null 2>&1 && OUTPUT_TXT=$(composer update 2>&1) && printf "%s

" "$OUTPUT_TXT" && if echo "$OUTPUT_TXT" | grep -q "Nothing to modify"; then termy_say "All php packages are already up to date" > /dev/null 2>&1; else termy_say "Composer update completed" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi
